scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
scripts.dev: bash -c 'source "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" 2>/dev/null; nvm use 22 >/dev/null 2>&1; node scripts/require-node18.mjs && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"'
